svg.title: One memory saving, gains from <1% to 28.9%
svg.desc: Separate measurements from PR 59591. Throughput gains increase from under 1% at concurrency 32 and 48 to 7.9% at 64 and 28.9% at 70. At 70, the prefix-cache hit rate increases from 74.8% to 80.1%. Reported points have no repeated-run uncertainty intervals.
